phases.title: Shared setup that actually runs
phases.increment: Everyone can run the same app and tests
phases.outcome: everyone can clone, install, start the app and run a small test suite.
phases.order_parallel: agree on folders and install command first; S and T then work independently. No trained-result placeholders.
phases.gate: on each member's environment, `python -m pytest -q` and `streamlit run app/Home.py` work. Record commands and results, not just screenshots.

phases.title: Read and validate real FD001 data
phases.increment: Real FD001 files load, validate and display
phases.outcome: real engine records display in the app.
phases.order_parallel: S writes quality tests against the agreed schema while A writes the loader; T builds the view then connects it after A's return schema is ready. S runs the final report after real loading works.
phases.gate: demonstrate one actual engine; malformed-column and duplicate fixtures fail clearly; report matches loaded data. Raw files remain unchanged.

phases.title: Correct RUL labels and a useful engine explorer
phases.increment: Correct training RUL and engine exploration
phases.outcome: the app shows measured sensor trajectories and independently checked true training RUL.
phases.order_parallel: target tests and sensor charts run independently; the ground-truth tab waits for targets.
phases.gate: changing engine never mixes records; label tests pass; one member explains the formula using real records. Export a figure for later reporting.

phases.title: Safe development split and meaningful validation
phases.increment: Leakage-safe split and useful validation evaluator
phases.outcome: a reusable evaluator for partial histories of unseen development engines.
phases.order_parallel: A's manifest schema first; S writes scorer tests while T builds the audit view. Connect after manifest generation.
phases.gate: no fitting/validation engine overlap; prefixes contain no future rows; metric tests pass; official test labels unused. Numeric unit IDs in train/test may repeat: identity must include dataset partition.

phases.title: One reliable past-only feature extractor
phases.outcome: any valid engine prefix becomes the same ordered numeric feature vector.
phases.order_parallel: agree config first; S implements mathematics while A builds tests and T builds preview. Final gate runs actual code, not fixture-only output.
phases.gate: fixed field names/order; finite features for minimum supported history; future-data test passes; no target/identity field in model feature list.

phases.title: Model-ready tables, constant baseline and first Decision Tree
phases.increment: Reproducible feature tables, constant baseline and Decision Tree
phases.outcome: repeatable training and genuine validation numbers.
phases.order_parallel: S and T can build trainer shells and tests together; actual fitting waits for A's tables. Do not score fitting rows as validation.
phases.gate: one documented command rebuilds tables and trains the tree; metrics match per-engine predictions; fresh-process reload predictions match original outputs. Plot predicted versus actual validation RUL.

phases.title: First real deployed prediction
phases.outcome: the first complete working product slice.
phases.order_parallel: A and S agree service return structure; T can prepare page/deployment configuration in parallel. Remote parity waits for saved inference.
phases.gate: public app runs a saved trained model on a selected history; outputs match local inference; no true RUL enters prediction. If deployment fails, record the blocker and fix it before polishing the UI.

phases.title: Random Forest candidate
phases.outcome: a second evaluated, service-loadable regressor.
phases.order_parallel: A's trainer can run alongside P09-T and P10-S. S/T support happens after their own primary model packet or during a free slot; the phase gate waits for these checks.
phases.gate: actual held-out validation results, reload parity and real forest inference in the app. A stronger score than the tree is a result to measure, not a completion requirement.

phases.title: XGBoost candidate
phases.outcome: boosted regression under the same protocol.
phases.order_parallel: T's primary trainer is independent of P08-A and P10-S. Cross-check packets wait for their owners to be free.
phases.gate: saved boosted model, traceable metrics, service prediction and parity test. No assumption that XGBoost must win.

phases.title: PyTorch MLP candidate
phases.outcome: a trained neural network with reproducible CPU inference.
phases.order_parallel: S trains while A and T own their primary model packets. Saved MLP bundle precedes integration support. Keep this bounded; a stable weaker MLP is acceptable evidence.
phases.gate: neural network trains, loss is finite, best checkpoint and scaler exist, service inference matches offline inference. Backpropagation and the scaler's role can be explained by all three.

phases.title: Controlled model selection and small experiments
phases.outcome: a recorded, evidence-based choice of configuration.
phases.order_parallel: experiment allocations use separate output directories. Do not change global feature config during someone else's run. A/S produce results; T assembles then the team freezes decisions.
phases.gate: selected window/features/hyperparameters, justified production choice and frozen MLP refit epoch rule. Official test labels remain unused.

phases.title: Refit and freeze all final artifacts
phases.increment: All final models refitted and frozen
phases.outcome: final comparison and production models load without training.
phases.order_parallel: A and S refit independently; T prepares registry then verifies bundles as they arrive.
phases.gate: all four final bundles load, schema tests pass and parity checks succeed. No official test scores have influenced these decisions.

phases.title: Official held-out test evaluation
phases.outcome: trustworthy final ML results.
phases.order_parallel: evaluator and audit fixtures can be written independently; final display follows the executed evaluation.
phases.gate: correct official pairing, complete metric provenance and reproducible frozen evaluation. Re-running unchanged models for auditing is allowed; retuning against these test results is not part of this plan.

phases.title: Safe CSV upload
phases.outcome: a user-provided valid history runs through the same prediction service.
phases.order_parallel: agree schema/error codes first; all three packets then progress together. T's real prediction waits for validator integration.
phases.gate: clean uploaded CSV produces matching output; each malformed fixture returns a specific useful error without a public traceback.

phases.title: Fleet predictions with correct identity mapping
phases.outcome: multiple engines receive correctly attached predictions and priority sorting.
phases.order_parallel: agree output schema; S writes checks and T table while A builds service. Integration follows batch output.
phases.gate: batch/single parity and ID tests pass; sorting/filtering do not change predictions or lose engine identity.

phases.title: Historical prediction replay
phases.outcome: selecting an earlier cycle shows a prediction based only on its past.
phases.order_parallel: T can build slider/chart behavior while A builds service and S writes leakage fixtures.
phases.gate: future-row mutation test passes; slider and chart agree on cutoff; replay is labeled correctly and runs at bounded cost.

phases.title: SHAP explanations and model disagreement
phases.outcome: users can inspect feature contributions and compare estimates.
phases.order_parallel: S/A services work independently after bundle schema agreement; T creates layout then integrates actual outputs.
phases.gate: exact prediction/explanation version match; correct feature names; model table uses the same input prefix; missing explanations fail gracefully.

phases.title: Define the simulation and implement EDD
phases.increment: Defined simulation and working EDD scheduler
phases.outcome: a small maintenance scenario produces a valid, hand-checkable schedule.
phases.order_parallel: S's definitions and a tiny worked case come first; A and T then build decoder/UI in parallel. Freeze scoring before GA begins.
phases.gate: see the Appendix B worked example; no overlapping jobs on one team; all jobs scheduled once; penalty matches hand calculation. Early completion is allowed and not penalized in this initial objective.

phases.title: Genetic Algorithm with valid permutations
phases.outcome: a bounded optimizer returns a scored feasible schedule.
phases.order_parallel: S's valid initial population precedes operator integration; A can build independent invariants/exact tiny reference meanwhile. T connects when output contract is stable.
phases.gate: valid schedules, repeatable seeded output and exact-reference checks. With EDD seeded and elitism, returned best score must not exceed that seeded EDD score under the same objective; equality is entirely acceptable. This is a design invariant, not evidence that GA improves every scenario.

phases.title: Real model predictions drive both schedulers
phases.outcome: complete sensor-to-maintenance workflow.
phases.order_parallel: agree planner input snapshot first; A builds routing, S tests shared scoring and T builds controls. Compare both methods only from the same snapshot.
phases.gate: user selects real engine histories, predicts, selects a fleet and compares two valid schedules. Changing a buffer/capacity does not silently change model predictions.

phases.title: Complete connected application
phases.outcome: all major screens work as one product.
phases.order_parallel: three audits can run together on a fixed branch baseline; serialize shared-file fixes and rerun affected flows.
phases.gate: repeatable end-to-end demonstration without manual data substitution, mixed engine state, fabricated results or missing principal screens.

phases.title: Quantitative evidence beyond a single average
phases.outcome: report-ready error analysis and scheduling evidence.
phases.order_parallel: A/S studies run independently on frozen artifacts; T uses real outputs as they arrive. Bootstrap/noise studies can be cut first if time is short.
phases.gate: essential model error plots and paired scheduler comparisons exist with provenance. No metric-confidence interval is presented as an individual prediction interval.

phases.title: Full public release and remote checks
phases.increment: Full public release and remote smoke checks
phases.outcome: the complete product works outside development environments.
phases.order_parallel: T deploys first while A/S prepare checks; independent remote verification follows deployment.
phases.gate: public full flow and local/remote parity pass, including malformed input. A temporary screen recording does not substitute for the required working app/live demo.

phases.title: Independent reproduction and feature freeze
phases.increment: Clean-install and claim audit; feature freeze
phases.outcome: a stable release candidate with auditable claims.
phases.order_parallel: independent audits run together; shared corrections are merged sequentially and retested where affected.
phases.gate: clean install, public flow, mandatory tests and metric audit pass. No unresolved blocker. Cosmetic improvements are deferred.

phases.title: Complete report, slides and shared defense
phases.increment: Finished report, slides and rehearsed defense
phases.outcome: all academic material describes the implemented system accurately.
phases.order_parallel: chapter/slide finalization runs in parallel on separate sections; assembly waits for measured frozen content. Review final exports together.
phases.gate: report includes every mandatory section; slides contain actual qualitative/quantitative evidence; each member can explain and run the whole project, not only their own packet.

phases.title: Verify the submitted package
phases.outcome: a clean, complete, runnable delivery.
phases.order_parallel: source/evidence/document inventory can be checked together. Final extraction test must use the actual assembled ZIP, after any last modification.
phases.gate: all three review and sign off the exact archive; extracted code and deployed app work; group is ready for submission by 6 December and live demonstration 7-9 December. Preparing this plan does not submit anything.
